speaker: Bishop
content: Mixed-breeds... You mixed-breeds!

raw: [name="Bishop"]Herald! What's the meaning of this?! Why are they still alive? What of theirs is worth sparing?!
speaker: Bishop
content: Herald! What's the meaning of this?! Why are they still alive? What of theirs is worth sparing?!

speaker: Bishop
content: You must have realized they were nothing like you when first they slaughtered our bloodkin!

raw: [name="Bishop"]You are a holy being, and they are mere filth!

content: You are a holy being, and they are mere filth!

speaker: Gladiia
content: *Spit*...

speaker: Gladiia
content: Very flexible, eh?

raw: [name="Gladiia"]We hacked away at your kind with cold weapons so as to not expose you to our technology. That way, you will never become something we can't deal with.

content: We hacked away at your kind with cold weapons so as to not expose you to our technology. That way, you will never become something we can't deal with.

content: But I guess I overestimated. You don't seem very sensitive at all... Can't even adjust to this much?

raw: [name="Gladiia"]Looks like you just can't adapt to blades forged by Ægir technology. Am I right?

content: Looks like you just can't adapt to blades forged by Ægir technology. Am I right?

speaker: Bishop
content: Herald, she is insulting you!

raw: [name="Gladiia"]Bishop, oh, bishop... Can't you tell? Heh. Yes, I am confident I can kill you, and I could have done so right from the start.

content: Brother, why won't you accept them?

speaker: Seaborn
content: They are my sisters, and so they are your sisters too.

content: I can rouse you, rouse Ishar-mla, and, of course... Gla-dia too.

content: But our tribe cares.

speaker: Bishop
content: No... This is nonsense...

content: So you believe every single word in that good book you're holding? Let me remind you, Bishop, but you, too, are spreading heresy in full view of the Iberians.

raw: [name="Gladiia"]It doesn't matter to me one bit what this thing tells me, but you are from the Church of the Deep. Perhaps you should be taking notes?

content: It doesn't matter to me one bit what this thing tells me, but you are from the Church of the Deep. Perhaps you should be taking notes?

speaker: Bishop
content: Kill them... Kill them! Herald, do it! Their crimes are grave and unforgivable! They spout blasphemy against you and the sea!

content: If that is your wish... then I shall do it.

speaker: Bishop
content: Then kill the... wandering singer first. Kill the one in the red dress!

[name="Seaborn"]Because he is my kin, and so are you. He calls out to me, and so do you.

content: Because he is my kin, and so are you. He calls out to me, and so do you.

raw: [name="Gladiia"]Ægir are vile and hideous, aren't they? Admit it, Bishop.
speaker: Gladiia
content: Ægir are vile and hideous, aren't they? Admit it, Bishop.

raw: [name="Gladiia"]We are all foolish Ægir, and we like to apply what we think to lowlife beasts. You don't understand it at all.
speaker: Gladiia
content: We are all foolish Ægir, and we like to apply what we think to lowlife beasts. You don't understand it at all.

content: You mixed-blood!
